description: Build our message for this segment when our sellers do not use the message or buyers stay with what they have. Needs the product, segment, champion problem, alternatives, outcome, capability and proof. Returns proof gaps and current approach questions, champion and alternatives maps for human choices, then a message and proof plan after a pause. Optional agreed workshop claim is the starting point. Without a real customer result, buyer lines are unproved hypotheses and the next step is discovery questions. Chat carries the brief between calls.

brief.description: The segment brief carried unchanged between calls.

agreed_claim.description: The agreed claim from the ChatGPT Positioning Workshop, if available. The chain starts from it when given.

items.description: An alternative, including the current approach and doing nothing.

capability.description: The capability that could produce that outcome.

category.description: The category word you want to test.

desired_outcome.description: The outcome the buyer wants, without an illustrative improvement figure.

problem.description: The problem in the champion's words.

product_description.description: What the product does, from your own brief.

period.description: The period actually measured, not the publication date.

result.description: A real customer result, or the illustrative result kept out of buyer copy.

source.description: The source of the customer result, using https.

sector.description: Your sector in your own words.

items.description: The segment to work on. Keep its wording unchanged.

trigger.description: What makes the problem matter now.

weak_points.description: Your notes about weak points to test. They are not competitor facts.

choices.description: The champion and alternative choices confirmed by the buyer after reading the maps.

alternative.description: The alternative chosen from the map. Sent to the message tool word for word.

champion.description: The champion role or person the buyer chose. Confirmation is still a hypothesis until advocacy and access are evidenced.

champion_segment.description: The confirmed target customer wording in this segment. Sent to the value tool word for word.

confirmed.description: True only after the buyer confirms these choices in chat.

review_receipt.description: The receipt from the map call, carried by chat. The server stores no brief.

stage.description: Map first. After the buyer chooses, call message with the same brief, its review receipt and confirmed choices.

name: impact_build_segment_message
title: Build our message for this segment
